description: A single smooth line through six months of values, without point markers.
overview: The starting line chart: one smooth series without point markers, a month axis and a tooltip. Use it to show a trend over time when the overall shape matters more than individual readings.
usage: Replace `chartData`, point each `dataKey` at your fields and rename the `chartConfig` entry to set the label and color. Switch the `type` on the line to change the curve, or set `dot` to show markers.
notes: Focus the chart and use the arrow keys to step the tooltip through the points.
